sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 11)

purpose.zh: 练手臂撑住时身体还能摆，像真实支撑那样
purpose.en: Trains straight-arm support while your body swings, like the real move.

text.zh: 手臂一直锁直，以肩为轴前后摆
text.en: Arms locked straight, swing from your shoulders

text.zh: 肩往下压，别耸到耳朵边。
text.en: Press your shoulders down, away from your ears.

text.zh: 先小幅摆，前后都别高过杠面。
text.en: Start small, never swing higher than the bars.

commonErrors.en: Swinging so big you lose control.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前侧疼就把幅度改小
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulders hurts, swing smaller.

thomasSupplement.thomasAngle: 9 后侧支撑 / 13 前侧支撑
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 3 组 × 10–20 次（一来一回 1 次）
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
